headline: Google freezes open-source bug bounty program amid flood of AI-generated submissions
summary: Google has suspended submissions to its Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program after being flooded with invalid, AI-generated vulnerability reports, which outlets describe as 'AI slop' overwhelming the bug bounty program.

claims.statement: Google suspended its Open Source Software Vulnerability Reward Program (OSS VRP) submissions.

claims.statement: The suspension is due to a flood of invalid or AI-generated submissions.
